title: New Space owner day 1, 3 and 7 emails wait for a reasonable local hour, as the come-backs do

source.ref: Funnel and onboarding audit 2026-11-27 (project thread: Audit funnels and onboarding for Fergal; doc https://claude.ai/artifact/K6WJF8sPmATEFjjDNCr3sh)

detail: FOUND 2026-11-27: the operator lifecycle emails go out from the lifecycle-triggers cron at 00:00 UTC (vercel.json) with no local-hours window, unlike the launch come-backs and draft reminders (8am to 8pm in the person's zone, lib/launch/comeback.ts). Fix: reuse hourInZone and the same send window.

verify.note: Passes once the consequence in the title holds.
